description: This Java class 'TbLwM2mSecurityStore' manages security information for LwM2M protocol within the Thingsboard platform, including retrieving, storing, and registering security credentials and endpoints.

classes.name: TbLwM2mSecurityStore
classes.description: Manages security info for LwM2M protocol, including retrieval, storage, and endpoint registration.

methods.name: getTbLwM2MSecurityInfoByEndpoint
methods.description: Retrieves security info for a given endpoint.

methods.name: getByEndpoint
methods.description: Returns SecurityInfo for an endpoint, or fetches and stores it if not present.

methods.name: fetchAndPutSecurityInfo
methods.description: Fetches security info using credentials ID and stores it.

methods.name: registerX509
methods.description: Registers an endpoint with a registration ID.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes registration ID from endpoint, and possibly the endpoint itself.
